post.title: [Hiring] Fantasy / D&D Graphic Artist & Content Manager for a Discord Community — $200/month, ongoing
post.body:
**Adventuring To Die** is a D&D-themed Baldur's Gate 3 Discord community (est. October 2025). We're looking for an artist who can give the guild a consistent dark-fantasy look and stick around long term.

**Pay:** $200/month, paid monthly via PayPal Goods & Services. This is paid work, not exposure or a trial.

**What you'd make:**

- Website and Discord art: banners, headers, emotes, event graphics

- Profile pictures and banners for our 12-person staff team (each has a character theme)

- D&D character art and portraits, with a possible role as our go-to character artist

- Graphics for announcements and run promos

**What you'd manage:**

- Keeping our purple-and-gold, dark-fantasy style consistent across everything

- A simple monthly schedule of what's requested, done, and next

**Looking for:**

- A portfolio of fantasy, D&D, or character art

- Reliable turnaround and clear communication

- Comfort with feedback and revisions

- Knowing D&D or BG3 is a plus

**To apply:** use the form at [link] [link] (choose "Not sure – open to anything," put "Artist" at the top of your answer to "Why do you want to join the staff?", and include a portfolio link), or DM me here.
